news.title: Man accused of killing Atlanta nightclub owner arrested after 3 years on the run
news.summary: A man accused of killing a popular Atlanta nightclub owner in 2023 is now behind bars after spending more than three years on the run, police said.

news.title: Red Lobster employee wanted on felony warrants barricades himself into restroom, starts standoff in Cartersville
news.summary: When officers attempted to arrest the suspect, police said he tried to flee before barricading himself inside the business restroom. He was later arrested.

news.title: She left home to DoorDash. Hours later, her family found her dismembered body in container in Smyrna
news.summary: The 26-year-old's aunt says the family tracked her phone, confronted the teen now charged in the case and made the gruesome discovery after police left.

news.title: FBI offering $10K reward for suspect wanted for kidnapping, extortion
news.summary: According to the agency, Julious George Khalid and others portrayed themselves as law enforcement and stopped a victim at gunpoint on I-20 near Panola Road.

news.title: 2 arrested in connection with park shooting death
news.summary: Two suspects have been taken into custody in connection with the shooting death of a man at an Atlanta park earlier this month.

news.title: GBI investigates after officer shoots 2 dogs and owner
news.summary: A South Fulton man and his two dogs are back home after a Fairburn police officer shot all three during an encounter early Thursday morning.

news.title: Metro Atlanta city opens new public safety building
news.summary: The new facility replaces the Police Department’s previous arrangement of operating out of two separate sites.

news.title: 2 arrested, charged with murder in South Bend Park shooting, police say
news.summary: Two young men were arrested and are facing murder charges following a deadly shooting at South Bend Park earlier this month, according to Atlanta Police.

news.title: Wanted murder suspect from New York captured in Gwinnett County following manhunt, gunfight
news.summary: Kean Wiggins is charged in the deadly shooting of a woman that happened on May 6, 2026, in Albany, New York.

news.title: Metro Atlanta inmate dies after being found wounded, GBI investigating
news.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation is investigating the death of a 24-year-old DeKalb County Jail inmate found wounded in his cell.

news.title: Mystery surrounds man’s fire death
news.summary: A neighbor said the man found dead with burns inside a southwest Atlanta apartment was the kind of person who would step in to help others.

news.title: Missing woman found dismembered at metro Atlanta apartment; 18-year-old arrested
news.summary: Police are investigating after a woman was found dismembered at a Cobb County apartment complex.

news.title: Four teens caught stashing $1K in Target beauty products in car, police say
news.summary: Target called police after four 19-year-olds allegedly stole over $1,000 in merchandise, including 60 beauty products, in Newnan.

news.title: Woman's body found dismembered after officers respond to missing person call in Smyrna, 18-year-old charged
news.summary: Smyrna Police said on Facebook that officers responded to the Park Valley Apartments off South Cobb Drive on Wednesday night.

news.title: Murder suspect shot in gunfire exchange with officers in Gwinnett
news.summary: A New York murder suspect is in custody after opening fire on law enforcement officers during an hours-long manhunt in Gwinnett County on Thursday morning, according to authorities.

news.title: Man sentenced for 2024 DeKalb extended-stay double murder
news.summary: A 39-year-old Philadelphia man was sentenced Thursday to life without parole plus 10 years for a 2024 double murder at a Decatur-area extended-stay motel.

news.title: South Fulton man home after officer shoots him, two dogs
news.summary: A Fairburn police officer fired at dogs outside a home shortly after midnight Sept. 24, according to an initial incident report.

news.title: GBI investigates inmate death inside DeKalb County Jail
news.summary: Georgia Bureau of Investigation agents are probing the death of a 24-year-old Covington man found unresponsive inside a cell at the DeKalb County Jail on Wednesday.

news.title: 2 accused in fatal shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor
news.summary: Cobb County police arrested two men early Thursday morning in connection with the fatal shooting of 27-year-old Curdravious Clark at a Norfolk Southern railyard.

news.title: Two arrested in shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor near railway property in Austell
news.summary: Cobb County Police say two men, a 28-year-old and 26-year-old, are facing charges of murder and more.

news.title: Deadly shooting in North Druid Hills area began as road rage incident, warrants allege
news.summary: Parke Russell, 24, is facing a malice murder charge in the case from a week ago.

news.title: Person posing as Pittsburgh Steelers player scams Pennsylvania women out of $1,000
news.summary: Police say an unknown person "posing as Pittsburgh Steelers player Eli Heidenreich" approached a 20-year-old and a 50-year-old woman for the scam.

news.title: Man found dead in his bed after apartment fire in southwest Atlanta, officials say
news.summary: Fire officials are considering this an arson investigation.
